known_limitations: Arm-specific supplements make prompts necessarily non-identical because one arm must forbid and the other bind KCH.
Global user instructions already demand complete reading and terminal monitoring, reducing contrast.
One sequential pair cannot estimate a general failure-rate reduction.
The KCH arm uses explicit executable binding inside its prompt; this is not evidence of automatic host-level activation in a newly created projectless task.
